movement.s: Aneet & collabs went from 4% of May's posts to 29% of June's and July's. Followers ran +15.7K a week from 8 Jun to 19 Jul.

stories.line: Beauty brand, about 17 posts a week.
stories.why: Events, lips & cheeks, skincare, eyes & base and Aneet with creator collabs, in near-equal parts. The smallest of the five, Aneet's, does the most.
stories.key: Top % here is a post's rank on likes among Lakmē's own posts by day 7. Its overall rank leans on a follower count that is wrong for 57 posts.

stories.unit: its 11 posts with a famous face this week · the other 5: Top 52%
stories.why: Aneet's runway walk on Monday: 39K likes, Top 1%. Aditya Madiraju eating Delhi chaat: 17K, Top 4%. Across 51 posts, a famous face lands Top 13% on likes against 57% without, and the gap is still 29 points within the same slice.
stories.so: Put a face people know on it.

stories.unit: likes on the Ice Ceramide reel, 24 Oct · a usual Lakmē post: 352
stories.why: Aneet and the new balm, 56 seconds: raspberries and ice, the applicator, a line on the formula, then two more shades. 429 comments against a usual 15. One like every 31 plays; its other reels this month needed 266.
stories.so: One face, one product, said plainly.

stories.line: Its worst post this week: a model selling to the camera.
stories.why: A model dots the cream on her cheek and smiles into the lens. Eyes & base posts where someone faces the camera land Top 76% on likes (13 posts); the rest of eyes & base, Top 57%.
stories.so: Show the product working. Selling it to the lens isn't landing.

stories.unit: plays turned into a like on the 25 Oct balm reel · its usual: 1 in 266
stories.why: The same Ice Ceramide balm a day after Aneet's reel, this time on a model, with 7 comments. Aneet's version took one like every 31 plays.
stories.so: Same product, same week. The difference was who had it.

stories.unit: its 4 carousels this week · usual for carousels: Top 47.5%
stories.line: All four were from Fashion Week. The 12 reels landed Top 34.5% (usual 55%).

stories.unit: posts this week · usual 17 · last week 53
stories.line: Fashion Week ended on Monday with six posts; then about two a day.
stories.why: Monday's six were the finale, Aneet's walk among them. None went up on Thursday.
stories.so: 53 was the event, not a new pace. That week landed Top 45% on likes; this one Top 28%.

stories.unit: followers this week · 17th of 29 weeks on file
stories.line: Every day was up; the best was Monday's finale, +2,692.
stories.why: The day of the 46K-like Ice Ceramide reel brought +1,047. Since mid-August it averages +5,600 a week; Aneet's summer ran +15.7K.
stories.so: Its best posts don't bring more followers than the rest. They come from somewhere else.

stories.unit: posts this week landed in its top half on likes
stories.line: Its best week since Aneet's Skin Goals week: Top 28%.

reviews.s: Aneet and the new balm, 56 seconds. 46K likes: the runaway.
Aditya Madiraju eating his way through questions. 17K likes.
A model selling it to the lens. 142 likes.

stories.so: What it does: a calm, strong week after the Fashion Week flood. Its big moments still arrive with Aneet.
